title: AudioEvalManifest
description: WS24-11 (AVN-234): index of wake-word/STT eval clips. The audio itself lives in the team's private storage, never in Git -- this manifest only ever points at it.

status.description: FROZEN once every clip below has its consent and transcript filled in; OPEN while still collecting.

path.description: Path relative to the team's private audio storage root, not this repo.

speaker.description: First name or initials only -- no other personal data.

consent.description: Who confirmed the OK, and when (e.g. 'verbal OK, 2026-11-24').

transcript.description: Exact words said. Required for wake/command; omitted for noise (no spoken target).
